text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series challenge begins 
alongside Meisho Doto, a timid and clumsy 
Umamusume.

Her goal: to become a confident, dazzling 
Umamusume just like her generation peer, 
T.M. Opera O.

While encouraged by her friend 
Matikanefukukitaru, her roommate Air 
Shakur harshly criticizes her, stating 
that "according to the data, she's 
lacking."

Even so, never giving up is her greatest 
strength. Believing that salvation 
awaited, Meisho Doto began to run.
